description: Reglas para productos defectuosos y faltantes/incorrectos en Morena Mia. Incluye procedimientos de reemplazo, evidencia en video, y manejo de devoluciones.

steps: Request a short video (30 seconds to 1 minute) showing and explaining the malfunction.
Escalate to technical team for verification.
Check stock availability. If the model is discontinued, offer the nearest equivalent alternative (e.g., Marvelous Signature Pro for Gold, Gorilla Device for Jelessi).
If a return is required, generate a Return Label (RL). The replacement is sent when the defective item arrives at the warehouse (or earlier for priority cases).
Ship overnight. Always attach the FedEx tracking link in the ClickUp comment.
content.customer_guidelines: Check items against receipt, take clear photos/videos of packaging and products, notify immediately via email or WhatsApp.
content.warehouse_notes: Defective returns take ~14 days for processing before new shipment. For urgent cases, replacement can be initiated once the customer drops off the package at FedEx. Compensations are recorded in 'Master Shippings'.

steps: Verify if the product was listed on the invoice and if it was supposed to be shipped (or given in store).
Check Master Shipping to confirm if it was actually sent.
Request photo evidence of all received products.
If confirmed missing/wrong, ship replacement overnight and attach FedEx tracking in ClickUp.
content.reason_codes: Use 'Missing Products' or 'Wrong Product' as the reason for compensation.
